        site_packages_dirs.append(site.USER_SITE)

    ]

# Priority 2: If not in site-packages, it's highly likely a local module or not an SDK we target.

skill_drafts.name: Package Installation Detection
skill_drafts.description: Determine whether a Python module is an installed library (in site-packages) or a local module, to decide whether to apply instrumentation. Uses normalized path comparison against site-packages directories.
contraindications: module path already known to be local or excluded
module __file__ attribute is None or unavailable
workflow_steps: Retrieve site-packages directories using site.getsitepackages() and site.USER_SITE
Check if module_path starts with any site-packages directory path
Return True if match found; return False if no match after all directories checked
triggers: module import interception during dynamic package loading
need to decide whether to apply instrumentation to a package
constraints: module_path must be normalized using os.path.normcase and os.path.realpath
site-packages directories must be retrieved via site.getsitepackages() and site.USER_SITE
all path comparisons must use normalized paths
handle case where site.getsitepackages() returns a string instead of list
cautions: Path normalization is critical for cross-platform compatibility
site.USER_SITE may be None; check existence before adding to list
site.getsitepackages() may return string or list; handle both cases
output_contract: Boolean return value: True if module is an installed library in site-packages; False if module is local or not in any site-packages directory.

metadata.prompt: Check if a module's file path is located within any site-packages directory. Normalize both the module path and site-packages directories using os.path.normcase and os.path.realpath. Compare the module path against all normalized site-packages directories (including user site if present). Return True if the module is found in any site-packages directory; return False if it is a local module or not in any site-packages location.

skill_drafts.name: Conditional Package Instrumentation Decision
skill_drafts.description: Determine whether a specific package should be instrumented based on current state, target package lists, and agentic library presence. Routes instrumentation eligibility by checking if a package is in TARGET_PACKAGES and evaluating agentic library state.
contraindications: package is not in target list
agentic library check is not yet complete
workflow_steps: Check if package_name is in TARGET_PACKAGES set
Apply special-case logic for agentic libraries and providers
triggers: evaluating whether to activate instrumentation for a package
constraints: Requires global _has_agentic_library flag to be initialized
Requires TARGET_PACKAGES set to be populated before invocation
output_contract: Returns boolean: True if package should be instrumented, False if instrumentation should be skipped. Caller uses result to decide whether to activate instrumentation for the package.

metadata.prompt: Given a package_name, check if it should be instrumented. Consult the global _has_agentic_library flag and TARGET_PACKAGES set. Return True if the package is eligible for instrumentation (in target list and not already instrumented), False otherwise. Handle special cases for agentic libraries and providers.
